title: HackerRank: Divisible Sum Pairs
description: Given an array of integers `ar` and an integer `k`, determine the number of `(i, j)` pairs where `i < j` and `(ar[i] + ar[j]) % k == 0`.
constraints:
2 <= len(ar) <= 100, 1 <= k <= 100
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(k)
starter_code:
def divisible_sum_pairs(n: int, k: int, ar: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def divisible_sum_pairs(n: int, k: int, ar: list[int]) -> int:
    remainder_counts = [0] * k
    total_pairs = 0
    for x in ar:
        rem = x % k
        comp = (k - rem) % k
        total_pairs += remainder_counts[comp]
        remainder_counts[rem] += 1
    return total_pairs
explanation: Remainder frequency counting finds matching pairs with sum % k == 0 in O(N) time and O(k) space.
